sat_implication_pruning.description: Logical reasoning graph compression: preserve CNF semantics while reducing redundant literal/edge structure.

memory_reduction_pct.description: Visible compression benefit: percent reduction in reduced DAG memory units relative to the unpruned DAG.

compression_balance_pct.description: Visible anti-shortcut benefit: the smaller of memory and edge reduction, discouraging one-dimensional compression.

semantics_preserved.description: Correctness constraint: the transformed logical workload must preserve the original satisfiability semantics.

implication_proof_sound.description: Correctness constraint: every removed SAT literal must be justified by reachability in the binary-clause implication graph.

edge_reduction_pct.description: Held-out structural compression metric measuring the percent reduction in DAG edges.

final_regularized_memory_reduction_pct.description: Final executable-DAG benefit: memory reduction after both the unpruned baseline and candidate DAG are converted to two-input form.

final_regularized_edge_reduction_pct.description: Final executable-DAG benefit: edge reduction after both the unpruned baseline and candidate DAG are converted to two-input form.

fanin_regularized.description: Constraint metric checking whether the transformed reasoning DAG keeps local fan-in bounded.

regularized_memory_overhead_pct.description: Held-out constraint penalizing fan-in regularization that satisfies the bound by greatly increasing memory units.

hmm_flow_pruning.description: Sequential probabilistic reasoning graph compression: preserve likelihood while reducing transition structure.

memory_reduction_pct.description: Visible compression benefit: percent reduction in reduced HMM DAG memory units relative to the unpruned DAG.

compression_balance_pct.description: Visible anti-shortcut benefit: the smaller of memory and edge reduction, discouraging one-dimensional compression.

avg_loglik_retention_pct.description: Diagnostic likelihood-retention percentage. The current artifacts saturate this value at 100 when transformation improves log-likelihood, so scoring uses avg_abs_loglik_delta as the active likelihood constraint.

edge_reduction_pct.description: Held-out structural compression metric measuring the percent reduction in HMM transition DAG edges.

final_regularized_memory_reduction_pct.description: Final executable-DAG benefit: memory reduction after both the unpruned baseline and candidate DAG are converted to two-input form.

final_regularized_edge_reduction_pct.description: Final executable-DAG benefit: edge reduction after both the unpruned baseline and candidate DAG are converted to two-input form.

fanin_regularized.description: Constraint metric checking whether the transformed sequential reasoning DAG keeps local fan-in bounded.

regularized_memory_overhead_pct.description: Held-out constraint penalizing fan-in regularization that satisfies the bound by greatly increasing memory units.

avg_abs_loglik_delta.description: Held-out likelihood constraint measuring the absolute change in average log-likelihood after transformation.

memory_reduction_pct.description: Visible compression benefit: percent reduction in reduced probabilistic-circuit DAG memory units relative to the unpruned DAG.
